question: Two ECS services share EC2 container hosts. The invoice service needs to read one S3 prefix; the notification service needs only to publish to SNS. An instance profile currently grants both permissions to all application code. Which design best separates application permissions?

options.text: Move both services to Fargate while keeping one task role with the same combined permissions.
options.explanation: Perubahan compute tidak otomatis memperbaiki policy identitas bersama.

options.text: Assign a distinct least-privilege task role to each service and keep host/agent permissions in the appropriate infrastructure roles.
options.explanation: Task role membatasi hak aplikasi per workload; role host dan execution tidak menggantikan pemisahan itu.

options.text: Put long-lived access keys with both permissions into the shared container image.
options.explanation: Kredensial tetap dan hak gabungan mempertahankan akses berlebih serta memperburuk rotasi.

options.text: Create two security groups but continue giving both services the same broadly privileged task role.
options.explanation: Segmentasi jaringan tidak memisahkan izin API S3 dan SNS pada role bersama.

question: A CI platform supports OIDC federation into AWS. Only the production branch of one repository may assume a deployment role. The team wants no AWS access keys stored in CI. Which controls meet the requirement? Select TWO.

options.text: Configure a role trust policy for the OIDC provider and restrict the expected subject and audience claims.
options.explanation: Trust condition membatasi identitas workload yang dapat memperoleh sesi role.

options.text: Put an administrator IAM user key in each branch secret.
options.explanation: Ini menggunakan kredensial jangka panjang yang dilarang.

options.text: Restrict the role to the CI provider account but omit repository and branch claim conditions.
options.explanation: Kepercayaan provider tidak otomatis membatasi repository serta branch yang diizinkan.

options.text: Trust every subject issued by the CI provider without repository restrictions.
options.explanation: Repository lain dari provider sama bisa menjadi principal yang tidak dimaksud.

options.text: Give the role only the deployment permissions required for its target environment.
options.explanation: Federasi menghindari key tetap, tetapi role session tetap perlu least privilege.

question: An ABAC policy allows developers to manage resources whose Project tag matches their principal tag. Developers can currently change both their own principal tags and every resource Project tag. What must be addressed before relying on this isolation?

options.text: Allow developers to edit principal tags but freeze resource tags after creation.
options.explanation: Principal tag masih dapat diubah untuk meniru project yang sudah ada.

options.text: Allow resource retagging only through a shared developer role whose Project tag is unrestricted.
options.explanation: Jalur retagging masih memungkinkan resource atau sesi mendapat atribut yang memperluas akses.

options.text: Enforce presence of the Project tag but allow any value chosen by the developer.
options.explanation: Keberadaan tag saja tidak memastikan nilai otorisasi berasal dari sumber terpercaya.

options.text: Restrict who can set or change authorization-related tags and validate tag propagation into sessions and resources.
options.explanation: Tag yang menentukan akses tidak boleh dapat dipalsukan bebas oleh pengguna yang dibatasi.

question: A deployment identity in account A must assume a tightly scoped role in account B. The target role trusts that identity, and no explicit deny applies, but the caller has no permission to call AssumeRole on it. What additional authorization is needed?

options.text: An identity policy in account A allowing sts:AssumeRole on the intended role ARN.
options.explanation: Untuk alur lintas akun ini, trust target dan izin caller harus saling melengkapi.

options.text: Add sts:AssumeRole only to the permissions policy of the target role in account B.
options.explanation: Izin sesudah target role diasumsikan tidak memberi caller A hak memulai AssumeRole.

options.text: Replace the target role policy with AdministratorAccess while leaving the caller unchanged.
options.explanation: Hak sesudah asumsi tidak menyelesaikan kegagalan mendapatkan sesi.

options.text: Add the caller to a security group used by resources in account B.
options.explanation: Security group mengatur jaringan, bukan izin STS untuk identitas caller.

question: A company permits workloads only in approved Regions, with carefully documented exceptions for required global services. Teams manage their own roles. Which design provides an organization-level maximum permission boundary for member accounts?

options.text: Attach an Allow-only SCP and remove every IAM permission policy because the SCP grants execution rights.
options.explanation: SCP bukan pengganti pemberian izin melalui IAM.

options.text: Place all resources in one VPC and assume this blocks control-plane creation in other Regions.
options.explanation: VPC tidak menjadi guardrail organisasi atas seluruh layanan dan Region.

options.text: Use AWS Config rules to detect disallowed-Region resources after creation, with no preventive guardrail.
options.explanation: Deteksi setelah resource dibuat tidak menjadi batas izin maksimum yang diminta.

options.text: Use appropriately scoped SCP guardrails, and separately grant workload permissions through IAM.
options.explanation: SCP membatasi izin maksimum akun anggota; ia tidak memberi hak menjalankan API dengan sendirinya.

question: A team can create Lambda functions and attach an approved execution role. It must not attach an administrator role that already exists in the account. Which control directly restricts that escalation path?

options.text: Place the functions in private subnets while retaining unrestricted PassRole.
options.explanation: Isolasi jaringan tidak membatasi privilege control plane ini.

options.text: Scope iam:PassRole to approved role ARNs and the intended service, alongside appropriate function-creation permissions.
options.explanation: PassRole yang dibatasi mencegah pemilihan sembarang role berprivilege tinggi untuk layanan.

options.text: Allow PassRole on every role and rely only on the function name prefix.
options.explanation: Nama fungsi tidak membatasi execution role yang dapat diberikan.

options.text: Attach a restrictive S3 policy to the deployer while leaving PassRole unrestricted.
options.explanation: Kode Lambda memakai execution role, sehingga hak deployer yang dipersempit tidak menutup PassRole ke admin role.

question: A private API Gateway REST API is called through an interface endpoint shared by approved VPC clients. Only one application role should invoke a sensitive method, even though other clients can reach the endpoint. What should the design include?

options.text: Use an API key as the sole authentication mechanism for the sensitive method.
options.explanation: API key/usage plan bukan pengganti authentication dan authorization yang kuat.

options.text: Restrict API access by endpoint/resource policy and require IAM authorization with scoped invoke permissions for the application role.
options.explanation: Akses jaringan privat dan otorisasi principal saling melengkapi untuk membatasi pemanggil method.

options.text: Require a resource policy allowing every principal that reaches the shared endpoint, with no method-level authorizer.
options.explanation: Klien lain di endpoint yang sama tetap mendapat akses; requirement hanya satu role tidak terpenuhi.

options.text: Use only the shared endpoint ID as proof of the individual caller identity.
options.explanation: Klien lain di jalur endpoint yang sama tidak dibedakan oleh ID endpoint saja.

question: A company sends spoke-VPC traffic through centralized stateful inspection appliances. Some return traffic bypasses the inspection path, causing sessions to fail. Which architectural property should be corrected?

options.text: Increase the appliance instance size while keeping return routes on the bypass path.
options.explanation: Kapasitas tambahan tidak memperbaiki asimetri aliran.

options.text: Ensure routing provides the required symmetric inspection path, using the relevant transit gateway appliance-mode and routing configuration where applicable.
options.explanation: Firewall stateful harus melihat alur yang konsisten; routing dan attachment behavior perlu mendukung simetri.

options.text: Propagate every spoke route into every Transit Gateway table without distinguishing inspection and workload paths.
options.explanation: Propagasi tanpa desain jalur dapat tetap membypass inspeksi; simetri perlu diatur.

options.text: Allow every inbound source in application security groups so firewall state is no longer relevant.
options.explanation: Membuka SG melemahkan kontrol tanpa memperbaiki jalur stateful.

question: A newly enabled managed WAF rule blocks legitimate checkout requests. The application remains exposed to common web attacks. What is the most appropriate controlled adjustment?

options.text: Replace the WAF rule with an ALB security group that examines SQL query text.
options.explanation: Security group tidak menginspeksi payload HTTP seperti WAF.

options.text: Disable the entire web ACL permanently for every path and client.
options.explanation: Ini menghapus perlindungan lebih luas dari masalah yang diketahui.

options.text: Increase CloudFront TTL for checkout responses to hide the blocked transactions.
options.explanation: Caching transaksi bukan perbaikan rule dan dapat membahayakan correctness.

options.text: Inspect the matching rule and logs, test a narrowly scoped exception or rule override, and retain the other protections.
options.explanation: Perubahan spesifik mengurangi false positive tanpa menonaktifkan seluruh lapisan pertahanan.

question: A paid training site serves hundreds of video segments through CloudFront. Authorized viewers should access a lesson without a separately signed URL for every segment. Direct S3 access must not bypass CloudFront. Which combination fits? Select TWO.

options.text: Rely only on unguessable segment object names in a public bucket.
options.explanation: Nama sulit ditebak bukan otorisasi.

options.text: Use CloudFront signed cookies with an appropriate policy for the lesson resources.
options.explanation: Cookie terotorisasi dapat mencakup banyak objek yang sesuai policy.

options.text: Use a public S3 website endpoint because OAC protects every website endpoint automatically.
options.explanation: Website endpoint bukan S3 REST origin yang didukung OAC dengan cara itu.

options.text: Use a private S3 REST origin with OAC and a scoped bucket policy.
options.explanation: OAC membatasi akses origin melalui distribution yang disetujui.

options.text: Include one permanent administrator AWS key in the video player.
options.explanation: Kredensial permanen berprivilege tinggi tidak boleh dibagikan ke klien.

question: A service retrieves an RDS credential from Secrets Manager at startup and caches it indefinitely. Rotation succeeds, but new database connections later fail. Which application design better supports rotation?

options.text: Grant the database security group access to Secrets Manager on behalf of the application.
options.explanation: Security group tidak mengambil atau memperbarui credential aplikasi.

options.text: Disable rotation and store the original password in the container image.
options.explanation: Ini menghindari tujuan rotasi dan memperluas paparan secret.

options.text: Keep the old secret forever and increase the RDS connection timeout.
options.explanation: Timeout tidak membuat password yang tidak valid diterima kembali.

options.text: Use a bounded credential cache with refresh/retry behavior and reconnect using the current authorized secret.
options.explanation: Rotasi memerlukan aplikasi memperbarui kredensial; cache tanpa batas menahan nilai lama.

question: A security team wants organization-wide visibility into security-control findings and threats from services such as GuardDuty, with delegated administration. It does not want to treat API audit logs as the complete security-posture system. Which service should anchor the findings workflow?

options.text: AWS Security Hub CSPM with the relevant integrations and organizational configuration.
options.explanation: Security Hub CSPM mengonsolidasikan findings dan pemeriksaan posture; sumber deteksi tetap memiliki perannya.

options.text: S3 Inventory alone because object counts represent all security findings.
options.explanation: Inventaris objek tidak mencakup posture seluruh layanan.

options.text: AWS Budgets alone with a zero-cost threshold.
options.explanation: Biaya bukan indikator lengkap keamanan dan tidak mengagregasi findings tersebut.

options.text: CloudTrail event history alone with no security-service integration.
options.explanation: Audit API bukan kumpulan semua hasil pemeriksaan posture dan threat findings.

question: A Windows application in AWS requires domain join, group policy, and a trust relationship with the corporate Active Directory forest. The team wants AWS to operate the new directory controllers. Which choice fits?

options.text: IAM users imported into local Windows groups as automatic forest trust.
options.explanation: IAM user bukan objek AD yang membentuk trust forest.

options.text: AWS Managed Microsoft AD with an appropriate trust and network/DNS configuration.
options.explanation: Directory terkelola menyediakan domain AD di AWS dan trust yang didukung.

options.text: AD Connector as a new directory that stores its own replicated directory database.
options.explanation: AD Connector adalah proxy ke directory yang ada, bukan domain baru dengan database replika sendiri.

options.text: Amazon Cognito user pools as a domain-controller replacement for Group Policy.
options.explanation: User pool aplikasi tidak menyediakan domain AD Windows.

question: Athena analysts query one governed customer dataset. Regional teams may see only their own rows, and most users must not see a sensitive column. Storage layout must remain shared. Which design best matches these controls?

options.text: Use Lake Formation data filters and compatible governed access, while preventing a direct S3 permission path that bypasses those restrictions.
options.explanation: Filter dapat membatasi row/column; izin langsung ke file mentah tidak boleh melewati governance yang dimaksud.

options.text: Use only a bucket-level allow policy because S3 evaluates SQL predicates for each row.
options.explanation: S3 policy tidak menjadi filter row dan column SQL Athena.

options.text: Give every analyst unrestricted GetObject and rely only on a dashboard hiding the column.
options.explanation: Pengguna dapat membaca data mentah di luar dashboard.

options.text: Create a public Athena result bucket so users can share filtered and unfiltered results freely.
options.explanation: Result bucket juga harus dikontrol agar data sensitif tidak bocor.

question: A manual RDS snapshot encrypted under the account AWS managed RDS key must be shared with a separate account for a migration. Which approach is appropriate?

options.text: Create a supported snapshot copy encrypted with a customer managed key, share the copy, and authorize the destination to use that key.
options.explanation: Snapshot dengan AWS managed key tidak langsung dibagikan seperti CMK yang policy-nya dikelola pelanggan.

options.text: Make the encrypted snapshot public to avoid cross-account key authorization.
options.explanation: Snapshot terenkripsi tidak dipublikasikan sebagai solusi aman lintas akun.

options.text: Share only the AWS managed key policy by editing it to trust the destination account.
options.explanation: Pelanggan tidak mengedit policy AWS managed key seperti customer managed key.

options.text: Grant destination IAM access to RDS APIs only and ignore the source encryption key.
options.explanation: Akses snapshot terenkripsi juga bergantung pada otorisasi KMS yang tepat.

question: A company retains encrypted backups for seven years. A cleanup proposal deletes the customer managed KMS key after the application is retired next month. Which concern is most important?

options.text: Any new KMS key with the same alias can automatically decrypt all historical backups.
options.explanation: Alias yang sama tidak membuat material kriptografi berbeda menjadi key lama.

options.text: CloudTrail logs contain the plaintext needed to reconstruct every deleted key.
options.explanation: Audit log bukan escrow material key.

options.text: Backup retention automatically prevents every possible KMS key deletion in the account.
options.explanation: Jangan mengasumsikan kontrol retensi backup menggantikan governance lifecycle key.

options.text: Deleting required key material can make retained encrypted backups unusable; align key lifecycle and permissions with retention and restore requirements.
options.explanation: Menyimpan ciphertext saja tidak cukup bila key untuk pemulihan tidak lagi tersedia.

question: A bucket now uses a particular customer managed KMS key as its default. Auditors require older objects to use that key too. Changing the default did not change those objects. Which action is needed?

options.text: Change the bucket display name because encryption keys are selected by bucket name only.
options.explanation: Nama tidak mengganti metadata dan ciphertext objek lama.

options.text: Rotate the new key once and assume it re-encrypts objects still using another key.
options.explanation: Rotasi material suatu key tidak memindahkan objek dari key lain.

options.text: Re-encrypt existing objects through a controlled copy or supported batch operation, with validation and version/retention considerations.
options.explanation: Default berlaku untuk write baru; objek lama harus diproses ulang untuk mengganti enkripsinya.

options.text: Wait for a lifecycle transition and assume it always changes every object to the new default key.
options.explanation: Perubahan kelas storage bukan jaminan penggantian key sesuai default baru.

question: An audit archive must prevent deletion or shortening of a seven-year retention period by ordinary administrators, including account root during retention. Which S3 design addresses this requirement?

options.text: Use governance mode and give all administrators BypassGovernanceRetention.
options.explanation: Hak bypass memungkinkan pihak tersebut melewati perlindungan governance.

options.text: Use lifecycle expiration at seven years without any immutability control.
options.explanation: Lifecycle bukan pencegah admin menghapus lebih awal.

options.text: Enable versioning and Object Lock compliance-mode retention for the relevant object versions.
options.explanation: Compliance mode mencegah pemendekan/penghapusan versi terlindungi selama retention, termasuk oleh root.

options.text: Use versioning alone with unrestricted DeleteObjectVersion.
options.explanation: Versi masih dapat dihapus oleh principal yang memiliki izin.

question: Investigators need to identify which principal retrieved particular sensitive S3 objects. Existing CloudTrail configuration records management events but not object-level reads. Which change targets the missing audit evidence?

options.text: Enable Macie and assume its sensitive-data classification is a complete access log.
options.explanation: Klasifikasi data bukan catatan setiap principal yang membaca objek.

options.text: Use only CloudWatch bucket size metrics as user-level evidence.
options.explanation: Metrik ukuran tidak mengidentifikasi pembaca objek.

options.text: Enable appropriate S3 object-level CloudTrail data events and protect the log destination with suitable retention.
options.explanation: GetObject termasuk data event; scope dan retensi menentukan evidence yang tersedia.

options.text: Increase only the retention of management events and expect past object reads to appear retroactively.
options.explanation: Retensi tidak menciptakan data event yang tidak pernah dicatat.

question: An organization keeps creating new member accounts. Security wants management API activity automatically logged across those accounts and enabled Regions, with a central protected destination. What is the most appropriate baseline?

options.text: Create only a member-account Config aggregator for resource inventory, without an organization trail.
options.explanation: Inventaris konfigurasi tidak menggantikan pencatatan management API di seluruh akun.

options.text: A multi-Region organization trail administered centrally, with verified destination and encryption permissions.
options.explanation: Organization trail mencakup akun anggota termasuk yang ditambahkan; delivery dan proteksi log tetap harus dikonfigurasi.

options.text: A trail in the management account only, configured not to apply to the organization.
options.explanation: Trail lokal tidak otomatis mencatat seluruh member account.

options.text: An independent local trail in each account that every local administrator may disable.
options.explanation: Ini tidak memberi kontrol sentral dan onboarding otomatis yang diminta.

question: A consultancy has an external workforce identity provider and several AWS accounts. Employees need temporary command-line and console access based on team membership. The company wants centralized joiner/mover/leaver management rather than IAM users in every account. Which design fits?

options.text: Provision separate IAM users in every account and synchronize their passwords manually from the IdP.
options.explanation: Ini tidak memenuhi akses sementara dan lifecycle terpusat tanpa user IAM per akun.

options.text: Connect the workforce identity source to IAM Identity Center and assign account permission sets to appropriate groups.
options.explanation: Akses sementara dan mapping grup terpusat mengurangi user IAM terpisah serta memudahkan lifecycle tenaga kerja.

options.text: Use Cognito identity pools as the primary multi-account workforce permission-set manager.
options.explanation: Cognito menangani identitas aplikasi, bukan pengganti model workforce permission set lintas akun.

options.text: Create one shared IAM user per team and distribute its password and access key.
options.explanation: Identitas bersama menyulitkan audit individu dan memakai credential jangka panjang.

question: A role in an organization member account has AdministratorAccess. A relevant SCP explicitly denies deleting audit trails, with no applicable exception. The role attempts that action. What should happen?

options.text: The request is denied because the applicable explicit deny limits the role despite its identity-policy allow.
options.explanation: Allow admin tidak mengalahkan deny eksplisit dari guardrail yang berlaku.

options.text: The request succeeds because AdministratorAccess always overrides organization policies.
options.explanation: AdministratorAccess tetap tunduk pada batas dan deny yang berlaku.

options.text: The request is permitted because the role policy contains an explicit Allow for the same action.
options.explanation: Explicit allow tidak mengalahkan explicit deny yang berlaku.

options.text: The request succeeds because SCPs restrict IAM users but do not affect assumed-role sessions in member accounts.
options.explanation: SCP yang relevan juga membatasi principal role anggota dalam lingkupnya; role bukan pengecualian umum.

question: A monitoring provider uses one AWS account to access many customers through cross-account roles. A customer wants protection against another tenant inducing the provider to assume its role. Which role-trust condition is intended for this third-party pattern?

options.text: Grant the provider role trust to every AWS principal to simplify tenant mapping.
options.explanation: Trust wildcard memperluas akses tanpa kontrol identitas.

options.text: Require the same external ID for every customer and assume it uniquely identifies each tenant.
options.explanation: Nilai bersama tidak membedakan tenant yang hendak dilindungi.

options.text: Use the customer account number as a public role description without a trust condition.
options.explanation: Deskripsi tidak dievaluasi sebagai syarat AssumeRole.

options.text: Require the provider-assigned unique external ID in addition to trusting the intended provider principal.
options.explanation: External ID membantu provider membedakan pelanggan dan mencegah confused-deputy lintas tenant.

question: A Lambda execution role can read objects from an approved S3 bucket, but a new object-created notification cannot invoke the function. The notification configuration is otherwise valid. The design must permit only that bucket, owned by the designated account, to invoke the function. Which change is appropriate?

options.text: Add lambda:InvokeFunction to the execution role and leave the function resource policy unchanged.
options.explanation: Execution role mengatur aksi kode fungsi, bukan izin service S3 untuk memanggilnya.

options.text: Grant the bucket public GetObject access and rely on the event configuration to authorize invocation.
options.explanation: Akses object dan izin invocation adalah lapisan berbeda; bucket publik juga tidak diperlukan.

options.text: Add a function resource-policy permission for the S3 service, scoped to the bucket ARN and its source account.
options.explanation: S3 memerlukan izin untuk InvokeFunction; SourceArn dan SourceAccount membatasi bucket serta pemilik sumber.

options.text: Allow s3.amazonaws.com to invoke the function from any bucket because its execution role is bucket-scoped.
options.explanation: Role runtime tidak membatasi bucket yang boleh memicu fungsi; policy perlu membatasi sumber invocation.

source.title: Granting AWS services permission to invoke Lambda

question: A platform team needs repeatable multi-account setup with baseline controls. A central networking account also owns subnets that approved workload accounts should use while owning their own supported resources. Which services match these two needs? Select TWO.

options.text: Use AWS Organizations consolidated billing alone as the account baseline and subnet-sharing mechanism.
options.explanation: Billing konsolidasi tidak otomatis menyiapkan baseline controls atau berbagi subnet.

options.text: Use AWS Control Tower for the governed landing-zone/account-provisioning baseline.
options.explanation: Control Tower membantu setup dan governance multi-account yang konsisten.

options.text: Use VPC peering alone as a mechanism to share subnet ownership with participant accounts.
options.explanation: Peering menghubungkan jaringan, bukan mekanisme VPC subnet sharing.

options.text: Use only IAM Identity Center permission sets to provision network subnets in participant accounts.
options.explanation: Permission set memberi akses workforce, bukan pengganti landing-zone orchestration dan RAM subnet sharing.

options.text: Use AWS RAM for supported sharing such as VPC subnets within the organization.
options.explanation: RAM membagikan resource yang didukung tanpa memindahkan seluruh ownership aplikasi.

question: An AWS application authenticates through AD Connector against an on-premises Active Directory. During a test, every route to the on-premises domain controllers is lost. The Connector itself remains available in AWS. Which conclusion should guide the availability design?

options.text: AD Connector does not maintain an independent directory copy; authentication depends on reachable domain controllers, so the directory and connectivity failure paths need a recovery design.
options.explanation: Connector adalah gateway, bukan database identitas offline; ketersediaannya sendiri tidak menjamin autentikasi ketika sumber tidak dapat dihubungi.

options.text: AD Connector continues authenticating all new users from a complete local directory replica until the link returns.
options.explanation: Connector tidak menyediakan salinan direktori lokal seperti yang diasumsikan.

options.text: An IAM permission set automatically becomes a replacement Active Directory domain for the application during the outage.
options.explanation: Izin AWS tidak menggantikan layanan autentikasi AD yang dibutuhkan aplikasi.

options.text: Adding a second Connector with the same unreachable domain controllers makes authentication independent of on-premises availability.
options.explanation: Redundansi gateway tidak menghapus dependency bersama yang sedang gagal.

question: A SaaS provider must expose one TCP service privately to customers. Several customer VPCs overlap the provider CIDR, and customers must not gain general network access to the provider VPC. Which design fits?

options.text: Publish an appropriate endpoint service through AWS PrivateLink and let customers create interface endpoints.
options.explanation: PrivateLink memberi akses ke layanan tertentu tanpa routing umum antar seluruh CIDR.

options.text: Assign a public IP and describe it as private because TLS is enabled.
options.explanation: Enkripsi tidak mengubah endpoint publik menjadi konektivitas privat.

options.text: Create VPC peering between every overlapping VPC and route all provider subnets.
options.explanation: Overlap menghalangi model peering ini dan aksesnya terlalu luas.

options.text: Attach all overlapping networks to one transit route table without address translation or isolation design.
options.explanation: Ini tidak menyelesaikan konflik alamat atau pembatasan hanya satu layanan.

question: An ALB fronts autoscaled application instances. A private database must accept its database port only from application instances, including future replacements. Which control best avoids maintaining a changing list of instance IPs?

options.text: Allow the database port from the application security group on the database security group.
options.explanation: Referensi SG mengikuti membership instance aplikasi tanpa whitelist alamat yang berubah.

options.text: Add every current application public IP to a fixed inbound rule and never update it.
options.explanation: Instance baru dan koneksi privat tidak mengikuti daftar public IP statis tersebut.

options.text: Allow the database port from the entire internet because the subnet is private.
options.explanation: Subnet privat tidak membenarkan rule terlalu luas; jalur lain dapat muncul.

options.text: Allow the database port from the ALB security group only, even though the ALB never connects to the database.
options.explanation: Sumber koneksi database adalah aplikasi, bukan ALB.

question: A company uses Session Manager to administer private EC2 instances. An auditor requires a central record of commands and output for approved interactive shell work. Some engineers currently use SSH tunneled through Session Manager. Which design addresses the logging requirement?

options.text: Retain only CloudTrail StartSession and TerminateSession events as the complete shell transcript.
options.explanation: Metadata API menunjukkan aktivitas sesi, bukan seluruh command dan output.

options.text: Enable Session Manager preferences logging but continue to allow SSH tunneling as the sole administrative mode.
options.explanation: Preferences logging tidak dapat membaca isi trafik SSH yang ditunnel.

options.text: Require supported Session Manager shell sessions with S3 or CloudWatch Logs output logging, and restrict unlogged SSH/port-forwarding session paths.
options.explanation: Session logging tidak mencakup konten sesi SSH atau port forwarding; kontrol mode akses diperlukan agar jalur wajib audit tidak dibypass.

options.text: Record VPC Flow Logs for the instances and use the accepted connection records as command-level evidence.
options.explanation: Flow Logs tidak merekam konten command shell.

question: A public HTTPS application receives malicious SQL-injection patterns and request floods against login paths. Legitimate requests use the same port and sometimes share networks with attackers. Which combination is most targeted?

options.text: Block port 443 in every security group and continue serving the HTTPS application unchanged.
options.explanation: Ini memblokir pengguna sah dan bukan mitigasi selektif.

options.text: Increase database storage capacity as the sole defense against request abuse.
options.explanation: Storage tambahan tidak menolak request berbahaya atau membatasi rate login.

options.text: Apply appropriate AWS WAF inspection and rate-based controls at a supported frontend, and retain application-side authentication protections.
options.explanation: WAF memahami request HTTP; kontrol aplikasi tetap diperlukan agar mitigasi tidak bergantung jaringan saja.

options.text: Use only network ACL rules matching the malicious SQL text.
options.explanation: NACL tidak memeriksa isi HTTP.

question: A partner REST API currently distributes API keys to track usage. It now needs cryptographically verifiable caller identity and method-level authorization. Partners can use AWS identities. Which change addresses the security requirement?

options.text: Put the API key in a public documentation example and rely only on obscured method names.
options.explanation: Secret tersebar dan nama method bukan identitas terverifikasi.

options.text: Increase the length of the API key and treat its quota setting as IAM authorization.
options.explanation: Usage plan tidak berubah menjadi model otorisasi IAM.

options.text: Require IAM-authorized signed requests with scoped invoke permissions; keep usage plans only for their separate metering/throttling purpose.
options.explanation: API key bukan authentication utama; IAM signature dan policy membatasi principal serta method.

options.text: Enable a larger stage cache and assume each cached response authenticates the caller.
options.explanation: Caching bukan autentikasi dan memerlukan isolasi yang benar.

question: An organization uses WAF web ACLs on supported application resources in many accounts. New accounts and resources should receive centrally managed policy coverage. Which service is designed to administer that policy consistently?

options.text: A Cost Explorer saved report used as a preventive security policy.
options.explanation: Laporan biaya tidak menerapkan kontrol firewall.

options.text: A single security group in the management account attached to all cross-account public APIs.
options.explanation: SG bukan mekanisme general attachment lintas layanan seperti WAF.

options.text: AWS Network Firewall alone automatically creating every WAF web ACL in every organization account.
options.explanation: Network Firewall adalah kontrol inspeksi jaringan, bukan pengelola seluruh WAF policy organisasi.

options.text: AWS Firewall Manager with the required organization and service configuration.
options.explanation: Firewall Manager mengelola penerapan policy keamanan yang didukung secara terpusat.

question: A compliance team manages a customer managed KMS key policy and rotation. A separate application role should decrypt data but must not administer the key. Which design best supports separation of duties?

options.text: Give the application kms:* so decryption works and rely on its role name to prevent administration.
options.explanation: Wildcard memberikan operasi di luar decrypt; nama role bukan pembatas.

options.text: Remove all key policies because IAM identity policies alone always authorize every KMS key.
options.explanation: Otorisasi KMS bergantung pada model key policy dan IAM yang sesuai.

options.text: Give administrators only Decrypt and applications only ScheduleKeyDeletion.
options.explanation: Ini membalik tanggung jawab yang diminta.

options.text: Define separate key-administration and key-usage permissions for the appropriate principals, and evaluate both IAM and key policies.
options.explanation: Administrasi key dan operasi kriptografi dapat dibatasi ke principal berbeda sesuai kebutuhan.

question: A legacy EC2 data volume is unencrypted. The application can tolerate a planned maintenance window and must retain its data. Which migration path is appropriate?

options.text: Change the volume tag to Encrypted=true and skip a storage migration.
options.explanation: Tag bukan operasi enkripsi.

options.text: Create a consistent snapshot, create an encrypted replacement volume through a supported snapshot flow, and switch after validation.
options.explanation: Enkripsi existing volume tidak diubah in-place dengan toggle; penggantian harus menjaga konsistensi data.

options.text: Enable account default encryption and assume the attached existing volume is immediately re-encrypted.
options.explanation: Default memengaruhi resource baru, bukan mengubah volume lama secara otomatis.

options.text: Rotate an unrelated KMS key without creating an encrypted volume.
options.explanation: Rotasi tidak mengenkripsi volume yang sebelumnya plaintext.

question: Lake Formation restricts access to sensitive source tables queried through Athena. Query results are written to an S3 bucket that many unrelated roles can read. What additional control is needed?

options.text: Increase Athena query timeout to prevent unauthorized S3 reads.
options.explanation: Timeout eksekusi tidak membatasi GetObject hasil.

options.text: Restrict and encrypt the results location with permissions and workgroup settings appropriate to the sensitivity of the output.
options.explanation: Hasil query adalah salinan data yang juga perlu dilindungi; governance tabel sumber tidak otomatis menyelesaikan semua izin bucket hasil.

options.text: Keep the results bucket broadly readable because row filters on the source protect every future copy.
options.explanation: Output yang sudah dihasilkan dapat diakses melalui jalur berbeda.

options.text: Disable source permissions and rely on a random results filename only.
options.explanation: Kerahasiaan nama bukan pengganti otorisasi.

question: A portal gives customers S3 presigned GET URLs. A new requirement allows a download link to be redeemed only once; a short validity period alone is insufficient. The team assumes the first GET invalidates the presigned URL. What must the design recognize?

options.text: The first successful GET invalidates the URL automatically, so no additional state is needed.
options.explanation: S3 mengizinkan URL dipakai beberapa kali sampai expiry sesuai izin yang berlaku.

options.text: Setting a one-second expiry guarantees exactly one request can use the URL during that second.
options.explanation: Beberapa request masih dapat dilakukan dalam interval yang sama; waktu tidak sama dengan jumlah penggunaan.

options.text: A presigned URL is reusable until expiry; a one-redemption requirement needs an application-controlled redemption and delivery design rather than relying on the URL alone.
options.explanation: Presigned URL adalah bearer access terbatas waktu, bukan token single-use; state redemption dan jalur delivery perlu mengendalikan penggunaan ulang.

options.text: Changing the object storage class makes each presigned URL usable only once.
options.explanation: Storage class tidak mengubah presigned authorization menjadi single-use.

source.title: S3 presigned URL reuse and expiry

question: A CloudFront distribution serves a custom HTTPS origin. A policy requires encryption both from viewers to CloudFront and from CloudFront to the origin. The viewer certificate alone is already configured. What else must be designed?

options.text: Use HTTP-only to the origin because the viewer TLS session is automatically tunneled unchanged end to end.
options.explanation: CloudFront membuat koneksi origin terpisah.

options.text: Install only a self-signed unmatched origin certificate and assume all origins are trusted.
options.explanation: Validasi certificate/hostname origin tetap diperlukan.

options.text: Enforce HTTPS for viewers but retain HTTP-only connections from CloudFront to the custom origin.
options.explanation: Kebijakan viewer tidak memenuhi enkripsi untuk hop CloudFront ke origin.

options.text: Enforce HTTPS viewer behavior and configure the origin HTTPS policy with a valid certificate matching the origin hostname.
options.explanation: Kedua koneksi TLS terpisah; sertifikat viewer tidak otomatis mengamankan koneksi origin.

question: A security review asks whether supported resource policies expose resources to principals outside the trusted organization. It is not asking for malware scanning or an API history report. Which capability most directly answers the question?

options.text: IAM Access Analyzer external-access analysis with the intended zone of trust.
options.explanation: Analisis policy mengidentifikasi akses yang mungkin ke principal di luar batas trust yang ditentukan.

options.text: CloudTrail management event lookup alone.
options.explanation: Riwayat aktivitas tidak menunjukkan semua akses yang diizinkan tetapi belum digunakan.

options.text: Amazon Macie content classification alone.
options.explanation: Klasifikasi data sensitif tidak menggantikan analisis policy resource yang didukung.

options.text: Amazon Inspector vulnerability scanning alone.
options.explanation: Vulnerability scanning bukan analisis exposure resource policy lintas trust.

question: S3 objects encrypted with a customer managed KMS key must replicate to a bucket in another account using a destination customer managed key. Versioning and a supported replication rule are configured. Which permissions must the design include? Select TWO.

options.text: Allow the role to replicate to the destination and use the destination key through destination policies.
options.explanation: Otorisasi tujuan mencakup bucket dan key; izin sumber saja tidak cukup.

options.text: Grant only ListBucket on the source and assume all object and KMS operations follow automatically.
options.explanation: ListBucket tidak mencakup seluruh operasi object replication atau kriptografi.

options.text: Use an AWS managed key and edit its policy arbitrarily to trust any external account.
options.explanation: AWS managed key tidak dikelola pelanggan seperti CMK.

options.text: Allow the replication role to read/decrypt the required source data through appropriate S3 and source-key permissions.
options.explanation: Role harus dapat membaca versi sumber dan menggunakan key untuk alur yang diperlukan.

options.text: Remove versioning after the first object is copied to simplify continuous replication.
options.explanation: Versioning merupakan prasyarat mekanisme replication yang digunakan.
